simple.meaning: עֹלֵלָה (ʻôlêlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “only in plural gleanings ; by extension gleaning-time.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֹלֵלָה (H5955) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 8:2, with occurrences in Judges, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Obadiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹלֵלָה (H5955) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֹלֵלָה (H5955) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֹלֵלָה (ʻôlêlâh) / H5955 is traced through Judges 8:2, Isaiah 17:6, Isaiah 24:13, Jeremiah 49:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: only in plural gleanings ; by extension gleaning-time

firstOccurrence.englishText: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

timeline.evidenceText: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.
For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
If grape gatherers came to you,
“If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

definitions.full: H5955. oleloth עוֺלֵלוֺת noun feminine plural intensive gleaning ( going over a second time ); — gleaning (of grapes and olives; לֶקֶט of grain), always figurative of remnant: absolute ׳ע Isa 17:6 (|| זַיִת כְּנֹקֶף ), 24:13 (simile; || id. , + בָּצִיר ), Jer 49:9 (compare בֹּצְרִים v a ) = Obadiah 5 (id.) ; construct בָּצִיר עֹלִלֹת Micah 7:1 ; figurative of warlike achievement אֶפְרַיִם עֹלְלוֺת Judg 8:2 (opposed to בָּצִיר ).
